nights.title: Michael Jackson  - Legacy
nights.name: Michael Jackson
nights.extract: Michael Joseph Jackson was an American singer, songwriter, dancer, and philanthropist. Dubbed the "King of Pop", he is widely regarded as one of the most significant cultural figures of the 20th century. His musical achievements broke American racial barriers and made him a dominant figure worldwide. Through his songs, music videos, concerts, and fashion, he transformed visual performance in popular music, popularizing street dance moves such as the moonwalk, the robot, and the anti-gravity lean. Jackson is often deemed the greatest entertainer of all time.

nights.title: Boy Golden
nights.name: Boy Golden
nights.extract: Boy Golden is the stage name of Liam Duncan, a Canadian alternative country singer-songwriter based in Winnipeg, Manitoba.

nights.title: Doja Cat - Tour Ma Vie World Tour
nights.name: Doja Cat
nights.extract: Amala Ratna Zandile Dlamini, known professionally as Doja Cat, is an American rapper and singer-songwriter. Regarded as the "Queen of Pop-Rap", she is known for her musical versatility, live performance skills and humorous internet presence. Billboard named her "one of the world's biggest pop stars" and "one of the defining pop stars of this era", and Time listed her as one of the world's most influential people in 2023.

nights.title: KORPIKLAANI
nights.name: Korpiklaani
nights.extract: Korpiklaani is a Finnish folk metal band from Lahti that was formerly known as Shamaani Duo and Shaman.
